# Marketing and growth

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `marketing`  
**Mission:** Acquire and activate the right customers with true claims, measured experiments and brand consistency.

## Startup stage

The founder does product marketing and one channel well. Pre-register each experiment with a hypothesis, metric and decision rule before spending.

## Agents operating in this department

`growth-lead`, `growth-marketer`, `cmo-marketing`
